Title: Cyrena.APIReferences.DocumentsExtension
Summary: The IExtension entry point for the API References extension. Implements Cyrena.Extensa.Core's Extension base class to integrate with the Extensa loader.
Content:
## DocumentsExtension

The `DocumentsExtension` class is the entry point for the `Cyrena.APIReferences` extension. It extends `Cyrena.Extensa.Models.Extension` and is discovered by the Extensa loader at runtime.

### Location
`DocumentsExtension.cs` in the root of the project.

### Implementation

```csharp
public class DocumentsExtension : Extension
{
    public override void BuildExtension(CyrenaBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.AddApiReferencePages();
    }
}
```

### Behavior
- `BuildExtension` is called by the Extensa loader during application startup.
- Delegates all registration to `CyrenaBuilderExtensions.AddApiReferencePages()`.
- The extension manifest (`extension.json`) declares:
  - `id`: `cyrena.api_references`
  - `name`: `API References`
  - `version`: `0.4.0`
  - `entryAssemblyFile`: `Cyrena.APIReferences.dll`
  - `dependencies`: `[{ "id": "cyrena.developer", "minVersion": "0.4.0" }]`
  - `requireFrameworkBuilder`: `true`

### Extension Manifest
```json
{
  "id": "cyrena.api_references",
  "name": "API References",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "entryAssemblyFile": "Cyrena.APIReferences.dll",
  "description": "Adds ability to document & remember coding structures, services, etc.",
  "dependencies": [
    { "id": "cyrena.developer", "minVersion": "0.4.0" }
  ],
  "requireFrameworkBuilder": true
}
```

### Usage
This class is automatically discovered by the Extensa loader. No manual registration is required.
